library.title: Write a deck. Share it. Watch it teach.
library.hint: Every study set in ChocoMemo is written by a person, not a publisher. Tidy one up, publish it, and someone else gets a whole course from it.

decks.title: Vocabulary decks
decks.hint: Group words into a themed deck — nature, animals, everyday things — and review it like a little e-book.

exam.title: Quiz sets
exam.hint: Turn a deck into a timed exam and see exactly which words still need steeping.

kana.title: Kana drills
kana.hint: Fast rounds through both syllabaries until the shapes come without thinking.

review.title: Spaced review
review.hint: Decks you downloaded come back on their own schedule, so nothing goes cold.

how.title: Your daily pour
how.hint: Four small steps, repeated every day — that's all it takes.

step1.title: Pick your language
step1.hint: Choose the tray you're studying today.

step2.title: Borrow a deck
step2.hint: Take a deck someone else wrote, or start from the built-in shelf.

step3.title: Drill and quiz
step3.hint: Short kana drills and vocabulary exam, five minutes at a time.

step4.title: Publish your own
step4.hint: Add the words you keep forgetting and share them back with the shelf.

cta.title: The pot's already on.
cta.hint: No sign-up walls between you and the first deck. Sign in only when you want your words to sync.
